description:
Get Brand Radar share-of-voice: how visible the property's brand is in AI-assistant answers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) versus its competitors, aggregated across all tracked prompts for the date range. Returns own_domain, a ranking of domains by share_of_voice (0-100 average visibility, each with visibility_change vs the equal-length preceding period), and a head-to-head competitor_comparison (prompts the brand wins/loses against the top competitor). This is the aggregate AI Tracker overview; use list_prompts / get_prompt_detail for per-prompt data. Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Brand vs competitor share of voice over the last 28 days.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_28_days"}
```

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.

name: get_ai_visibility_share_of_voice

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.
